title: Princess Wencheng Enters Tubo
synopsis: Read the story of Princess Wencheng’s journey to Tibet.

fullText.simplified:
文成公主入吐蕃

    在中国唐朝，有这样一位公主，她聪慧美丽，知书达理。为了汉藏两族的民族团结，她远嫁吐蕃和亲。她，就是赫赫有名的文成公主。
    一千多年前，唐太宗将文成公主许配给了吐蕃首领松赞干布，并派人护送公主去吐蕃。临行前，皇帝怕文成公主到吐蕃后思乡心切，便叫工匠制作了两面能照见家乡风光的日月宝镜，送给公主。
    文成公主一行人日夜赶路，艰苦跋涉。眼看离家乡越来越远，前方是广阔的草原，帐篷点点，牛羊成群。文成公主一路上非常想念父母和故乡，于是从怀中取出日月宝镜一看，镜子里出现了长安的热闹情景。文成公主想到自己远嫁异土国邦，今生都难回家乡，她伤心地哭了。但是她又想到自己和亲的使命是伟大而神圣的，于是毅然将日月宝镜扔到草原上。传说日月宝镜很快变成了两座大山，就是现在青海省的日月山。
    很快他们来到了中原和吐蕃的交界地。传说，文成公主想到这次真的要告别家乡了，顿时泪如泉涌，突然她的眼泪幻化成了草原上的一条小河。文成公主望着自己泪水汇成的河流，伤感地说道：“天下河水自古向东流，而我却要一生往西走！”谁知此话一出，河水立刻逆转了流向，开始自东向西流淌了。这时文成公主意识到了大自然是在引领她一路向西不要回头，于是她义无反顾地前行，向西进入了吐蕃。这条神奇的河流被后世称为“倒淌河”，成为了青海省的一道独特景观。
    就这样，文成公主一行人翻山越岭，走了一程又一程，终于来到了吐蕃的逻些城，也就是今天的西藏拉萨。年轻的松赞干布隆重地迎接了这位美丽的公主，并按照唐朝礼仪和她结成了夫妻。松赞干布非常喜欢这位聪慧美丽的文成公主，专门令人为她修建了一座城池，也就是现在世界上海拔最高的建筑——布达拉宫。
    文成公主从中原带来了青稞、油菜、小麦、荞麦等种子和各种先进的耕种技术，随同文成公主一起入吐蕃的，还有许多铁匠、木匠、石匠。从此，西藏有了五谷，老百姓学会了各种技艺，这些都大大促进了吐蕃的经济和文化发展。
    文成公主入吐蕃四十年，协助松赞干布治理吐蕃，赢得了吐蕃民众的敬重，也维护了唐蕃之间的和平局面。她为汉藏的和睦邦交做出了巨大的贡献，令后人敬仰。
fullText.traditional:
文成公主入吐蕃

    在中國唐朝，有這樣一位公主，她聰慧美麗，知書達理。為了漢藏兩族的民族團結，她遠嫁吐蕃和親。她，就是赫赫有名的文成公主。
    一千多年前，唐太宗將文成公主許配給了吐蕃首領松贊干布，並派人護送公主去吐蕃。臨行前，皇帝怕文成公主到吐蕃後思鄉心切，便叫工匠製作了兩面能照見家鄉風光的日月寶鏡，送給公主。
    文成公主一行人日夜趕路，艱苦跋涉。眼看離家鄉越來越遠，前方是廣闊的草原，帳篷點點，牛羊成群。文成公主一路上非常想念父母和故鄉，於是從懷中取出日月寶鏡一看，鏡子裡出現了長安的熱鬧情景。文成公主想到自己遠嫁異土國邦，今生都難回家鄉，她傷心地哭了。但是她又想到自己和親的使命是偉大而神聖的，於是毅然將日月寶鏡扔到草原上。傳說日月寶鏡很快變成了兩座大山，就是現在青海省的日月山。
    很快他們來到了中原和吐蕃的交界地。傳說，文成公主想到這次真的要告別家鄉了，頓時淚如泉湧，突然她的眼淚幻化成了草原上的一條小河。文成公主望著自己淚水匯成的河流，傷感地說道：“天下河水自古向東流，而我卻要一生往西走！”誰知此話一出，河水立刻逆轉了流向，開始自東向西流淌了。這時文成公主意識到了大自然是在引領她一路向西不要回頭，於是她義無反顧地前行，向西進入了吐蕃。這條神奇的河流被後世稱為“倒淌河”，成為了青海省的一道獨特景觀。
    就這樣，文成公主一行人翻山越嶺，走了一程又一程，終於來到了吐蕃的邏些城，也就是今天的西藏拉薩。年輕的松贊干布隆重地迎接了這位美麗的公主，並按照唐朝禮儀和她結成了夫妻。松贊干布非常喜歡這位聰慧美麗的文成公主，專門令人為她修建了一座城池，也就是現在世界上海拔最高的建築——布達拉宮。
    文成公主從中原帶來了青稞、油菜、小麥、蕎麥等種子和各種先進的耕種技術，隨同文成公主一起入吐蕃的，還有許多鐵匠、木匠、石匠。從此，西藏有了五穀，老百姓學會了各種技藝，這些都大大促進了吐蕃的經濟和文化發展。
    文成公主入吐蕃四十年，協助松贊干布治理吐蕃，贏得了吐蕃民眾的敬重，也維護了唐蕃之間的和平局面。她為漢藏的和睦邦交做出了巨大的貢獻，令後人敬仰。

This is now the world’s highest building above sea level – Potala.

sentences.simplified: 文成公主从中原带来了青稞、油菜、小麦、荞麦等种子
sentences.traditional: 文成公主從中原帶來了青稞、油菜、小麥、蕎麥等種子
sentences.pinyin: wén chéng gōng zhǔ cóng zhōng yuán dài lái le qīng kē yóu cài xiǎo mài qiáo mài děng zhǒng zi

sentences.simplified: 和各种先进的耕种技术，
sentences.traditional: 和各種先進的耕種技術，
sentences.pinyin: hé gè zhǒng xiān jìn de gēng zhòng jì shù
sentences.english: Princess Wencheng brought from the Central Plain seeds such as highland barley, oilseed rape, wheat, and buckwheat ..

sentences.simplified: 随同文成公主一起入吐蕃的，还有许多铁匠、木匠、石匠。
sentences.traditional: 隨同文成公主一起入吐蕃的，還有許多鐵匠、木匠、石匠。
sentences.pinyin: suí tóng wén chéng gōng zhǔ yì qǐ rù tǔ bō de hái yǒu xǔ duō tiě jiang mù jiàng shí jiàng
sentences.english: .. and various advanced cultivation technologies.

sentences.simplified: 从此，西藏有了五谷，老百姓学会了各种技艺，
sentences.traditional: 從此，西藏有了五穀，老百姓學會了各種技藝，
sentences.pinyin: cóng cǐ xī zàng yǒu le wǔ gǔ lǎo bǎi xìng xué huì le gè zhǒng jì yì
sentences.english: Accompanying Princess Wencheng to Tubo were also many blacksmiths, carpenters and stonemasons.

sentences.simplified: 这些都大大促进了吐蕃的经济和文化发展。
sentences.traditional: 這些都大大促進了吐蕃的經濟和文化發展。
sentences.pinyin: zhè xiē dōu dà dà cù jìn le tǔ bō de jīng jì hé wén huà fā zhǎn
sentences.english: Since then, Tibet had the five grains. Ordinary people learned all kinds of arts.
This all greatly propelled the development of Tubo’s economy and culture.

sentences.simplified: 文成公主入吐蕃四十年，协助松赞干布治理吐蕃，赢得了吐蕃民众的敬重，
sentences.traditional: 文成公主入吐蕃四十年，協助松贊干布治理吐蕃，贏得了吐蕃民眾的敬重，
sentences.pinyin: wén chéng gōng zhǔ rù tǔ bō sì shí nián xié zhù sōng zàn gàn bù zhì lǐ tǔ bō yíng dé le tǔ bō mín zhòng de jìng zhòng

sentences.simplified: 也维护了唐蕃之间的和平局面。
sentences.traditional: 也維護了唐蕃之間的和平局面。
sentences.pinyin: yě wéi hù le táng bō zhī jiān de hé píng jú miàn
sentences.english: Princess Wencheng was in Tubo for 40 years, helping Gampo to govern Tubo and winning the esteem of Tubo masses, ..

sentences.simplified: 她为汉藏的和睦邦交做出了巨大的贡献，
sentences.traditional: 她為漢藏的和睦邦交做出了巨大的貢獻，
sentences.pinyin: tā wèi hàn zàng de hé mù bāng jiāo zuò chū le jù dà de gòng xiàn
sentences.english: .. also safeguarding the peace between the Tang and the Tubo,

sentences.simplified: 令后人敬仰。
sentences.traditional: 令後人敬仰。
sentences.pinyin: lìng hòu rén jìng yǎng
sentences.english: She made a huge contribution to peaceful diplomatic relations between the Han and the Tibetans, ..
.. earning the reverence of later generations.

raw.synopsis: Read the story of Princess Wencheng’s journey to Tibet.
sentence_translations: Princess Wencheng Enters Tubo
In the Chinese Tang dynasty, there was such a princess: she was intelligent and beautiful, educated and well-balanced.
In order to unite the Han and Tibetan peoples, ..
.. she married far away into the Tubo dynasty to achieve peace though kinship relations.
She was the distinguished Princess Wencheng.
More than 1,000 years ago, Emperor Taizong of Tang betrothed Princess Wencheng to the head of the Tubo dynasty Songtsen Gampo, ..
.. and dispatched people to escort the princess to Tubo.
Before departure, the emperor was afraid Princess Wencheng would be homesick after arriving in Tubo.
So he told artisans to make a sun and moon mirror able to reflect the scenery of her hometown on both sides and gave it to the princess.
Princess Wencheng and her entourage hastened on their journey day and night. It was an arduous trek.
Soon they grew more and more distant from her hometown.
A vast prairie lay ahead with specks of tents and herds of ox and sheep.
Princess Wencheng greatly missed her parents and hometown the whole way.
Thereupon, she took out the sun and moon mirror from her bosom. As soon as she looked, ..
.. the bustling scenery of Chang’an appeared in the mirror.
Princess Wencheng thought of herself being married off to another state.
It would be difficult for her to return to her hometown in this lifetime. She cried with a broken heart.
But she thought of her mission to achieve peace though kinship relations as great and sacred.
As a result, she resolutely threw the sun and moon mirror onto the prairie.
It is said that the sun and moon mirror very quickly became two large mountains, ..
.. the Riyue Mountain in today’s Qinghai province.
Very soon they arrived at the boundary between the Central Plain and Tubo.
It is said that when Princess Wencheng thought that she would really have to bid farewell to her hometown this time ..
.. she immediately she burst into tears, and her tears suddenly became a small river on the prairie.
Princess Wencheng looked at the river that had converged from her own tears, and said sadly, ..
.. “The rivers under heaven have flowed east since ancient times, yet throughout my life I must always head west!”
Unexpectedly, as soon as this was said, the river immediately reversed direction and started to flow from east to west.
At this point, Princess Wencheng became aware that nature was leading her west never to turn back.
Thereupon, she moved forward without looking back, heading west and entering Tubo.
This mystical river was named the “Daotang River” by later generations, ..
.. and has become a unique landscape in Qinghai province.
It this way, Princess Wencheng and her entourage passed over mountains ridges, going on and on, ..
.. and finally arrived at Tubo’s Luoxie city, which is today’s Lhasa in Tibet.
The young Songtsen Gampo grandly welcomed the beautiful princess, ..
.. and following Tang dynasty ceremony they became husband and wife.
Songtsen Gampo liked the intelligent and beautiful Princess Wencheng very much, ..
.. and specially gave an order to build an ancient city for her.
This is now the world’s highest building above sea level – Potala.
Princess Wencheng brought from the Central Plain seeds such as highland barley, oilseed rape, wheat, and buckwheat ..
.. and various advanced cultivation technologies.
Accompanying Princess Wencheng to Tubo were also many blacksmiths, carpenters and stonemasons.
Since then, Tibet had the five grains. Ordinary people learned all kinds of arts.
This all greatly propelled the development of Tubo’s economy and culture.
Princess Wencheng was in Tubo for 40 years, helping Gampo to govern Tubo and winning the esteem of Tubo masses, ..
.. also safeguarding the peace between the Tang and the Tubo,
She made a huge contribution to peaceful diplomatic relations between the Han and the Tibetans, ..
.. earning the reverence of later generations.
